registered: before running r29_bandit.py (user request: dynamic allocation with bandits / RL)
method: exponentiated-gradient (EXP3-style full-information bandit) on top of the v9.8 equal-risk weights: at each month start, multiplier m_i proportional to exp(eta x trailing 182-day Sharpe of sleeve i), normalised to mean 1 over active sleeves, clipped to [0.5, 2]; Sharpe from days before the month only

trials.B contextual bandit: eta = 0.5, Sharpe measured only on past days in the same BTC context (close above / below its 200-day average, known the day before) and the multipliers for today's context used
